rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.key_value: 3% per year or 80% of CPI change, whichever is lower
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord can only raise your rent by up to 3% per year or less based on inflation, whichever is lower. If inflation is negative, your rent cannot be increased.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador solo puede aumentar su renta hasta un 3% por año o menos según la inflación, lo que sea menor. Si la inflación es negativa, no se puede aumentar la renta.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to residential rental properties except buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces rented after January 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions_text: Exemptions for residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces rented after January 1, 1990.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which must be stated in a written notice. Just cause includes certain at-fault and no-fault reasons such as nonpayment of rent, lease breaches, nuisance, criminal activity, owner occupancy, removal from rental market, demolition, or substantial remodel.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord cannot evict you without a valid reason after you have lived there for 30 days. Valid reasons include not paying rent, breaking lease terms, or the landlord needing the unit for themselves or to remove it from the rental market.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador no puede desalojarlo sin una razón válida después de que haya vivido allí 30 días. Las razones válidas incluyen no pagar la renta, incumplir el contrato o que el arrendador necesite la unidad para sí mismo o para sacarla del mercado de alquiler.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Does not apply to housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels, hospitals, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
rules.exemptions_text: Exemptions include housing built in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels, transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice. "Just cause" includes certain at-fault causes such as default in payment of rent, breach of a material term of the lease, committing a nuisance, criminal activity, and other actions. "Just cause" also includes certain no-fault causes such as the intent of the owner to occupy the property, removal of the property from the rental market, and demolition or substantial remodel.
